rationale: The Court is likely to issue a narrow, text-and-structure opinion holding that § 1101(a)(13)(C)(5) is conduct-based and permits the government to rely on later-developed evidence in § 1229a proceedings to establish the “has committed” trigger. Sotomayor (likely joined by Jackson) will emphasize reliance/fairness and the status-altering consequences of after-the-fact “arriving alien” treatment, while one or more conservatives may concur to stress limits, burdens, or due-process backstops.
